title: Shipping
text:
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the United States. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs $12.99.

Orders over $75 qualify for free standard shipping. Express shipping is never free.

Orders placed before 2 PM Eastern ship the same business day. Orders placed after the cutoff ship the next business day.

title: Order tracking
text:
When your order ships you receive an email with a tracking link. The tracking link is also available in your account under Orders.

Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours to appear after the shipping email. If tracking has not moved for 5 business days, contact support and include your order number.

title: Returns and refunds
text:
You can return items within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in the original packaging.

Start a return from the Returns page at https://demo-store.example/returns. Return shipping is free for defective items. For any other return a $6.95 label fee is deducted from your refund.

Refunds go back to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the item. Final sale items cannot be returned.

title: International shipping
text:
We ship to Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia. International shipping takes 7 to 14 business days.

Customs duties and import taxes are paid by the customer at delivery. We cannot ship to countries under trade restrictions.

title: Payments and billing
text:
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. Your card is authorized at checkout and charged when your order ships.

Sales tax is calculated at checkout from your shipping address. Invoices are available from the Orders page in your account. For invoice copies write to billing@demo-store.example.

title: Your account
text:
To reset your password choose Forgot password on the login page. The reset link is valid for 60 minutes.

To change your email address open Account settings and then Profile. You will need to confirm the new address by clicking the link we send you.

title: Warranty
text:
All headphones carry a 12 month limited warranty that covers manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover water damage or worn ear pads.

To make a warranty claim email photos and your order number to warranty@demo-store.example. A replacement ships within 3 business days after your claim is approved.

title: Aria headphones
text:
The Aria battery lasts up to 30 hours with noise cancelling off and 22 hours with noise cancelling on. A full charge takes 2 hours over USB-C.

Aria headphones connect with Bluetooth 5.3 and work with iOS, Android and Windows. Available colors are black, sand and sage.

Replacement ear cushions are sold separately for $14.

title: Contact and support hours
text: Our support team is available Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern. We answer emails within 1 business day. We do not offer phone support.
